title: Gần đây có nhà vệ sinh công cộng không?
englishTitle: Is there a public bathroom nearby?
pronunciation: Gan day co nha ve sinh cong cong khong
summary: For finding a public bathroom nearby when a cafe, station, park, or market does not make the direction obvious.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Gần đây có nhà vệ sinh công cộng không? is enough to start the next practical step.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Ask with the place around you visible: station sign, cafe entrance, market row, or map screen.

phrases.vietnamese: Gần đây có nhà vệ sinh công cộng không?
phrases.english: Is there a public bathroom nearby?
phrases.pronunciation: Gan day co nha ve sinh cong cong khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Nhà vệ sinh is the useful restroom phrase here; không? turns it into the question.

breakdown.vietnamese: có nhà vệ sinh công cộng
Gần đây có nhà vệ sinh công cộng không?
breakdown.english: Is there a public bathroom nearby?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Nearby follow-ups: Where is the bathroom?; Do you have toilet paper?; Can I use the bathroom?

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi dùng nhà vệ sinh được không?
phrases.pronunciation: toy zoong nya veh sinh dook khong

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use it near markets, parks, stations, or busy streets when a public restroom is the real need.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Nhà vệ sinh is the safer restroom word. Phòng tắm can sound like a shower or bath room.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Useful if the exchange continues: Do you have soap, Can I wash my hands here, and I need water.
